snippet.title: Outpour demo trailer | Thinky Direct 2026
snippet.description:
Outpour is a puzzle game where you redirect flowing water across dreamy cathedral rooftops. Manipulate your surroundings to guide a dynamic water system, traverse high places, and restore harmony to sacred structures.

Outpour by Andrew Leal @drooshayne now has a demo out!

Outpour in the Thinky Games DB:
https://thinkygames.com/games/outpour/
Outpour on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3615290/Outpour/

More info about the Thinky Direct:
https://thinkygames.com/events/direct/2026/

#thinkygames #puzzlegame #exclusive #trailer #indiegames #sokoban
